data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 1904 (commit 7d7f4778d3, trailer 3b78-0256-bf68-4748) from worktree land-experiment-artifacts branched at origin/main 74517a190e: the five docs/experiments/ artifacts committed verbatim (835 insertions, no existing file touched). Triage that motivated this ticket: the 4 tracked modifications in the operator checkout (criteria_routing.json + 3 governance-pin tests) were stale duplicates of already-merged change 1891/bc0bdaf39a — 3 files byte-identical to origin/main, criteria_routing.json an OLDER copy missing the surface-parity overlay (c1d1996e8b) — and were discarded after backup; docs/experiments/_summarize_review.py was an unreferenced throwaway stdin helper, also discarded after backup. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1.
